sentences.text: Sphagesaurus was an extinct notosuchian crocodylomorph belonging to the family Sphagesauridae.
The genus Sphagesaurus and its type species S. huenei were first described by Llewellyn Ivor Price in 1950.
The original description of S. huenei was based on two isolated molariform maxillary teeth.
The holotype specimen of S. huenei was discovered in a railway cut between Presidente Bernardes and Santo Anastácio in São Paulo state.
A referred specimen DGM 333-R was found near Catanduva in São Paulo state within the Bauru Group.
A second species, S. montealtensis, was named by Andrade and Bertini in 2008 based on a nearly complete skull and mandible.
The holotype of S. montealtensis was collected from the Bairro Cachoeira locality near Monte Alto in northern São Paulo from the Adamantina Formation.
In 2026, Kitayama and Bertini provisionally proposed that Armadillosuchus arrudai and Caryonosuchus pricei are junior synonyms of S. huenei.
Sphagesaurus is classified within the family Sphagesauridae.
The authority for the genus name Sphagesaurus is Price, 1950.
Sphagesaurus lived during the Campanian to Maastrichtian stages, from approximately 83.6 to 66 million years ago.
In 2013, the species S. montealtensis was reassigned to the genus Caipirasuchus, becoming Caipirasuchus montealtensis.
Kitayama and Bertini (2026) reviewed a skull with mandibular and postcranial remains as comparative material for S. huenei.
